clippings.speaker: Todd Haynes
clippings.quote: Julianne does something that few actors do. She disappears before your eyes. It becomes a ‘Can you find the woman in the picture?’ puzzle. It’s an amazingly selfless performance.
clippings.title: Nowhere to hide: Todd Haynes on [Safe]
clippings.context: Haynes, interviewed by Amy Taubin about casting Moore as Carol White, for the May 1996 issue (BFI republished it in 2023).

clippings.speaker: Todd Haynes
clippings.quote: It was Julianne who prompted a closer look. She started to watch the documentaries and she was like, “Todd, you have to check this out.”
clippings.title: “I like feeling uncertain, displaced and unnerved”: Todd Haynes on May December
clippings.context: Haynes on how Moore pushed him to research the Letourneau case and the sexual side of the story he had avoided.

clippings.speaker: Todd Haynes
clippings.quote: Her relationship to the camera — and her understanding of understatement and of eliciting an audience’s investment — that’s always astonished me about her. Not all actors understand that the way she does.
clippings.title: How ‘Far From Heaven’ captured the quietly traumatizing, technicolor world of the 1950s
clippings.context: Haynes, ahead of a 20th-anniversary Far From Heaven screening at Outfest, on the film he wrote for Moore.

clippings.speaker: Julianne Moore
clippings.quote: Todd is a master of construction, he really is. He has a formidable intellect, and a real knowledge of cinema; how you shape a scene, how you tell a story.
clippings.title: ‘May December’ Star Julianne Moore On Working With Todd Haynes
clippings.context: Moore, in a Deadline interview on May December, her fifth film with Haynes, on how he shapes a scene.

clippings.speaker: Julianne Moore
clippings.quote: I called Todd, and I said, “I’m thinking about this. I think it’s something very concrete then that I could have, that Natalie could imitate.”
clippings.title: ‘May December’ Star Julianne Moore On Working With Todd Haynes
clippings.context: Moore on how she came up with Gracie's lisp and phoned Haynes to pitch it.

clippings.speaker: Julianne Moore
clippings.quote: That was very much Todd’s voice. Everything was very scrappy. You didn’t make any money as an actor. You shot it very quickly.
clippings.title: Julianne Moore Explains What Drew Her to ‘The Debut’
clippings.context: Moore recalling the low-budget shoot of Safe, which Haynes made, in a profile tied to The Debut.
